wooded.linePrev: And as we drew south, the mist, it came down
wooded.line: The wooded ravine to the wandering stream
wooded.lineNext: The serpent, he moved, but no-one would say
stanza: The wooded ravine to the wandering stream
The serpent, he moved, but no-one would say
The depths of the waters, the bridge which distraught us
And brought to me thoughts of the ill-fated day
